scope: Executable Evidence for the one-command capture workflow only; not E1-E8 Go evidence, not H1/H2 human review, not Decision Continuity Product Value.
covered_boundaries: normal PASS publishes Evidence and verification
runner blocked keeps raw Evidence only
runner exit 0 without a readable record fails closed
runner exit 2 without a readable blocked record is not accepted as blocked
--replace with a missing runner record removes stale prior Evidence and verification
verifier failure is not promoted to PASS
Evidence and verification cannot share one output path
stop_line: Capture workflow self-test PASS != E1-E8 executable PASS != H1/H2 human review != Decision Continuity Product Value established.
